author: Rakkain
text:
Dear Salivan,

Your diagrams and chart above almost blew my mind. I am really trying to understand. I read OF article by Master FX Sniffer, but seems I don't get the most important part of it. The only part I can relate is shown below:

There is unfilled sell order above that FL, that's why price make a retrace after FL engulf. To fill this sell order, there should be same size of buy order. The deepest point of retrace is when all unfilled sell order got filled, and there is unfilled buy order in the opposite so price move up again. This is what I understand so far. But I don't know yet why sometime the big unfilled buy order is placed in far below the engulf (so price need to make a deep retrace), and why sometime those order is place just below the engulf (so price make just a little retrace).

Then, your question in this chart below, I will answer yes, I will trade in the future. But my only reason is: it is a FTB of that important FL. I can't relate it yet with OF.

Regrads, Raka

Good question, Not sure about it yet, but I think it has to do with order flow. If there are no clean (unfilled) orders left at key DPs (such as key FLs, QMs and origin) or price is compressed then it doesn't make sense for ITs to drive price there again. See eng 2, deep RT to QM (I bet on LTF there's a nice DP aligned). Instead on eng 1 and 3 price was compressed below.
